method: Official pages retrieved with functions.fetch_page for bounded source checks. The tool returned extracted page text, not retained raw HTTP or full-site archives. A retrieval confirms the returned content only; it does not certify every field or the project's model.

sources.label: NFL 2026 Week 11 injury-report request
sources.observed: The extracted page title said Week 10 of the 2026 season and the result URL was /injuries/league/2026/reg10, although /reg11 was requested.
sources.scope_limit: No Week 11 injury or game-status row was confirmed by this request. Treat every current Week 11 availability value as unknown.

sources.label: NFL 2026 Week 10 injury report (returned page)
sources.observed: The returned report displays Player, Position, Injuries, Practice Status, and Game Status columns.
sources.scope_limit: The inspected table did not expose a depth-chart tier or a replacement-for mapping. This is an observation about the returned report, not a claim that separate team publications never provide one. No Week 11 availability values are inferred.

sources.label: NFL 2026 Week 11 schedule
sources.retrieval_status: RETRIEVED — page title and selected schedule text
sources.observed: The page identifies the 2026 Week 11 schedule and links to NFL game pages.
sources.scope_limit: This session did not transcribe every game row; the URL is a source target for schedule and game-key collection, not a full-slate audit.

sources.label: NFL 2026 Week 10 scores
sources.retrieval_status: RETRIEVED — page title and selected content
sources.observed: The page is an NFL scores/results surface with links to individual NFL game pages.
sources.scope_limit: Scores are outcome evidence, not operator odds, prices, settlement terms, or a proof of predictive skill. This session did not audit every Week 10 score.

sources.label: NFL standings
sources.retrieval_status: RETRIEVED — page title and selected table content
sources.observed: The page identifies standings and links to division, conference, and league views.
sources.scope_limit: This session did not re-transcribe the 32-team table. Do not treat this link as a fresh verification of the project's 2026-11-04 snapshot.

sources.label: NFL directory of official team sites
sources.retrieval_status: RETRIEVED — page title and selected content
sources.observed: The NFL page labels itself as official sites of all 32 teams and links to team profiles and club websites.
sources.scope_limit: The directory is a route to official team sources; it is not itself evidence of a team's current depth chart or starter order.

sources.label: NFL 2026 player-stat categories
sources.retrieval_status: RETRIEVED — page title, categories, and selected content
sources.observed: The page lists passing, rushing, receiving, tackles, interceptions, and other player-stat categories.
sources.scope_limit: No player-season or player-game value was transcribed for this review. A stat category alone does not establish playing time, role, depth tier, or a replacement's causal impact.

sources.label: Next Gen Stats glossary
sources.observed: The glossary describes player-tracking context and metric definitions including completion probability, expected completion percentage, air yards, separation, and box defenders.
sources.scope_limit: Definitions are not player observations, forecast inputs, or evidence that a metric predicts a bet outcome. No NGS numeric value was transcribed here.

sources.publisher: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.label: NIST: scatter plots and association
sources.observed: NIST describes scatter plots as tools for identifying relationships and states that association does not prove causality.
sources.scope_limit: This is statistical context; it does not estimate any Own8 correlation or validate a betting strategy.

sources.publisher: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.label: NIST: confidence intervals
sources.observed: NIST describes intervals as ranges used to express uncertainty in estimating a population parameter and explains repeated-sampling interpretation.
sources.scope_limit: No Own8 interval or strategy performance is computed from this page.

sources.publisher: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.label: NIST: Bonferroni method for multiple comparisons
sources.observed: NIST describes a family-wise coverage method for a finite set of comparisons and notes that no one comparison method is uniformly best.
sources.scope_limit: Own8's proposed trial family and thresholds are project design, not NIST rules or endorsements.

sources.label: GRA: class licences and remote games of chance
sources.observed: GRA describes remote games of chance as having chance-based elements and prizes that may be money, money-equivalent, or something of value; it advises seeking legal advice if uncertain about classification.
sources.scope_limit: This project has not been legally classified. The page is a review trigger, not a determination that the project is or is not regulated.

sources.label: GRA: lottery and betting FAQ
sources.observed: GRA's FAQ describes activities that may constitute betting operations and explains that a prize can include money, money-equivalent, or another thing of value.
sources.scope_limit: No legal conclusion is made about a paper leaderboard, points, or any future reward structure. Obtain qualified advice before offering value or facilitating wagering.

sources.label: GRA: unlawful remote gambling activities
sources.observed: GRA provides official guidance on unlawful remote gambling activity in or from Singapore.
sources.scope_limit: This page is not used to assess an individual's location, eligibility, or the project's legal status.

sources.label: GitHub Pages publishing sources
sources.observed: GitHub documents branch-root or /docs publishing and custom Actions publishing, and states that Pages sites are publicly available on the internet.
sources.scope_limit: Repository permissions, a successful build, and public deployment must be verified separately; documentation does not prove this site's current deployment status.
